popup_hint: {scale}. Quiet passages = places where clicks are not masked by music.
meaning_nm: Near Mint: like new, no audible defects
meaning_vgp: Very Good Plus: light signs of play, occasional clicks
meaning_vg: Very Good: audible crackle and clicks, the music stays in front
meaning_gp: Good Plus: clear defects, plays through
meaning_g: Good: heavy crackle, many clicks, plays through without skipping
meaning_f: Fair/Poor: the stylus skips back or the record is damaged
role_secondary: pause: at most one step lower
scale_head_collection: In the collection: media condition from the Discogs entry, same scale
scale_head_measured: Measured: record grade from its sides
scale_head_measured_sides: Measured: record grade from its sides ({sides})
col_upper_limits_uncalibrated: Upper limits per grade (starting values, not calibrated)
scale_hint: Side grade = worst of the grading metrics; F only when the stylus skips back. Pauses cost at most one step, and only when they are at least {gap} steps worse. Record grade = average of the sides, half steps go to the worse grade. Grading scheme {version}.
